messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert INC123456 fired - metrics-pipeline: scrape_job failure (severity: P1). Auto-page to #eng-sre, primary on-call Jamal.

jamal: ack. i'm on it - pulling prometheus and exporter logs now. assigning temp owner to this thread.

incident-bot: Alert details:
```
alertname: ScrapeJobFailure
job: node-metrics-shard
shard: metrics-node-7
error: 503 from metrics-exporter-7
rate: scrape_failures[5m] > 0.7
started_at: 2026-03-15T02:14:22Z
```

alice: can we try routing that shard to the backup scrape-proxy? last time a similar flake was exporter-side and rerouting bought us time. also can we restart the exporter pod first?

jamal: good idea. running quick checks:
- kube events show repeated `OOMKilled` on metrics-exporter-7 around 02:13
- prometheus scrape errored ~02:14 per incident-bot
- log-ingest-backlog bumped to ~120k msgs (ingest rate down ~40%)

jamal: running restart command now:
```bash
kubectl rollout restart deploy/metrics-exporter-7 -n monitoring
kubectl get pods -l app=metrics-exporter -n monitoring -w
```

ben: taking over ops on this one — i'm scaling replicas while jamal watches logs. scaling to 3 replicas to absorb memory spikes.

ben: `kubectl scale deploy/metrics-exporter-7 --replicas=3 -n monitoring` executed. pods creating. watching startup logs.

ben: startup logs show exporter init ok but then crashloop on one replica; stack trace includes `java.lang.OutOfMemoryError` - looks like memory pressure.

alice: if it's OOM we should bump memory limits and roll a new revision with a higher heap, and enable the scrape-proxy fallback for that shard while we roll. I'll open a small patch to the k8s resource limits now.

jamal: agreed. patch applied, creating new replicaset. in the meantime i reconfigured prometheus target for `metrics-node-7` to go through `scrape-proxy-readonly` (fallback) to restore scrapes immediately.

jamal: prometheus now scraping through fallback proxy, last_success 02:18. backlog ingestion still high but ingest rate recovering (+20%).

kendra: customer-ops checking impact. which customers rely on that shard? any paid customers impacted?

jamal: quick impact summary:
- internal dashboards: delayed by ~2-3 minutes for most users, some widgets reliant on that shard showed stale values for ~8-12 minutes.
- external customers using streaming metrics from that node may see missing datapoints for a ~10-20 minute window.
- no API request rate errors observed (core APIs unaffected).

kendra: ok. i'll prepare a short advisory to the status page and mark severity as "degraded metrics" rather than full outage. draft below. please edit: 

customer-ops: "We are investigating an intermittent metrics ingestion issue affecting a subset of nodes. Some customers may see delayed or missing metrics; core product functionality is unaffected. Engineers are rolling fixes; we will follow up when scrapes are stable and backlog is drained."

jamal: that looks good. +1 to posting. please include ETA ~30-45 mins to full normalization.

sre-oncall: if jamal needs to hand off, i'll rotate the page to the next on-call after stabilization. jamal - do you want to stay or hand off to ben?

jamal: handing off to ben — i've confirmed fallback scrapes and applied resource patch; ben has scaled and is validating. i'll stay available for context but handing owner to Ben. @ben pls ack.

ben: ack — taking owner. continuing to monitor pods and the log-ingest drain. increasing kafka consumer parallelism for the ingesters to help backlog (temporary).

ben: kafka consumer lag reduced from ~120k -> 65k over 6 minutes after scaling consumers. ingestion rate back to ~85% of normal.

incident-bot: PagerDuty INC123456 escalated to next level due to auto-escalation policy (unacked by primary for 8m) — was acknowledged and reassigned to ben.

jamal: posting short runbook notes for postmortem:
- root cause: exporter memory pressure (OOM) on metrics-exporter-7 triggered cascade: repeated scrape failures -> prometheus retries + backlog pressure on log-ingest consumers.
- mitigation: reroute to scrape-proxy fallback; scale exporter replicas; bump memory limits; scale kafka consumers to drain backlog.
- follow-ups: add pod memory alert earlier than OOM; add test for fallback proxy routing during exporter flake; run a capacity test for the ingesters.

kendra: posted status page update with your draft and ETA. tagging affected customers list for support to send targeted emails if necessary.

ben: metrics pipeline looking stable. backlog at ~10k and draining, scrapes green for 3/3 replicas. will monitor for 30 more minutes then close.

customer-ops: prepared targeted customer notes for 12 affected customers; will wait for final confirmation before sending.

jamal: thanks team. final status for thread: mitigations applied, customer impact limited to delayed/missing metrics (no service degradation), PD incident still open until backlog < 1k and 30m stable.

incident-bot: PD INC123456 status changed to RESOLVED by ben — conditions met: backlog <1k and 30m stable. :white_check_mark:

ben: closing thread — will add follow-up tickets for alerts and runbook updates. thx all. :thumbsup:
